title: 5.7.2.4 Media Encryption Key Table Group - K_AES_256 (Object Table)

content.text:
This table is used to store media encryption keys, cipher mode of operation, and associated metadata
used with the Advanced Encryption Standard (see [12]).

tables.title: Table 228 K_AES_256 Table Description
tables.table_md:
| Column Number | Column Name | IsUnique | Column Type |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | UID | | uid |
| 0x01 | Name | Yes | name |
| 0x02 | CommonName | Yes | name |
| 0x03 | Key | | key_256 |
| 0x04 | Mode | | symmetric_mode_media |
